description: Cacao Ceremony + Sound Bath with Freqs of Love @ blosm studio
long_description:
Recalibrate with a cozy candlelit sound bath with hot Cacao, opening the heart and welcoming in quiet rest and simplicity during the season.

About this Event

New Moon Sound Bath with Freqs of Love @ Blosm Studio

Join us at blosm studio for a hot cacao ceremony, and get cozy for the season with a high-vibrational journey into stillness. You will be held through sound created by sacred instruments (Including an array of deep-resonance gongs, drums, crystal singing bowls, and ethereal chimes) in a 60-minute, powerful high-frequency reset sound bath for the Scorpio New Moon.
Through Freqs of Love's curated set of instruments and vocal toning, deep frequencies help entrain the brain and field, moving you from a state of overwhelm or exhaustion into an effortlessly deep, meditative Theta state. The mind moves into parasympathetic mode where the body can do its best healing.
We honor this season of dark by bringing in heart-opening intentions, twinkling candlelight, and sweet intentions for connection, community, peace, and warmth. Join us for a relaxing evening centered on nurturing you!

What to expect
Deep relaxation, intentions led with heart, and a sound journey unlike any other to center, ground, clear, and charge your energy for the month ahead. Bring a friend and settle in for a serious recalibration.

Yoga mats, bolsters, blankets, and water will be provided, but bring whatever props will help you get the most cozy.
No prior experience with sound baths needed, first-timers welcome!Doors open at 6:45pmStarts at 7:00pmDuration ~60 minutes with safe space share afterwardFree parking in lot availableAges 14+
